title: Tibet–Ladakh–Mughal war
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Tibet–Ladakh–Mughal war", at revision 1378669528, opens: "The Tibet–Ladakh–Mughal war of 1679–1684 was fought between the Central Tibetan Ganden Phodrang government, with the assistance of the Oirat Mongol Khoshut Khanate, and the Namgyal dynasty of Ladakh with the assistance from the Mughal Empire in Kashmir." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q15643653, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1679-1684 war". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
